instruction: Have Glitch plug the data shard into his deck and crack whatever is on it.

target.reason: The page has no verb for plugging an item into a deck or cracking its contents. The offered verbs are depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept and refuse, and none of the end-state forms (holder, location, said) can express a plug-in or crack. Handing Glitch the data shard would move the item but would not carry out the instruction.
